name: Minimum and Maximum Spanning Trees and Forests
problem_statement: Select an acyclic spanning subgraph minimizing or maximizing total edge weight independently within each connected component.

normalization: Preserve all declared vertices, including isolated vertices.
Preserve direction; an undirected projection must be explicitly requested.
Declare the treatment of self-loops and parallel edges before execution; an adapter must reject unsupported cases.

required_outputs.name: component_count
required_outputs.description: Number of trees, including isolated vertices.

solution_semantics.objective: Optimize total spanning-forest weight under the selected objective.
solution_semantics.exactness: Globally optimal forest; equal-weight alternatives are valid.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Output identities refer to the normalized input; any multiplicities must follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No output order or choice among equally valid optima is required unless specified by an input.

validation_rules: Selected edges are acyclic and preserve each input connected component.
Edge count equals vertex count minus component count.
Compare objective with a Kruskal oracle.

correctness: Selected edges are acyclic and preserve each input connected component.
Edge count equals vertex count minus component count.
Compare objective with a Kruskal oracle.
